comment.body:
Released in [v0.37.0](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/releases/tag/v0.37.0) through [PR #178](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/pull/178), at exact qualified merge `9f77410389c4e8738fdf94d3e69e7c8550fbc70c`. Annotated tag `5763142ce085111d8d8cdf0eefb248908b5eb4b2` is remotely verified and remains fixed.

Fourteen versioned properties update automatically for the exact designated ligand. Relevant edits retire incompatible values; matching source-qualified cache results, cancellation/recovery, late results, Undo/Redo and project changes retain current-input authority. Category options are installation-owned. Changed molecular previews deliberately show explicit Preview unavailability under the parent contract. Unsupported chemistry retains reasons, independent known counts and qualified charge; calculation preserves original uploads and canonical molecules without hidden preparation.

- Both complete 43-command gates pass. Fresh merged qualification: 3,598 Python tests/zero skips, 1,599 frontend tests, 14 supervisor checks, and 565 native passes with exactly 75 unchanged released exclusions across 640 cases. No failures, flakes, retries or new exclusions. Actual preceding-reader, migration, production/version/legacy checks pass.
- All seven specialist agent roles—scientific theory, scientific implementation, architecture, performance, UI, UX and reference workflows—PASS reviewed `8c70ddb0`; its whole tree matches the merge. Observer atomic publication, precise read failures, actual warm-baseline identity and editor readiness findings were corrected. Scientific methods, workloads and deadlines retain their definitions. Agent assessments are not human approval; normal merge/review policy was checked without bypass.
- Independent full readback verifies 2,146 current/preceding Git/disk/capsule source bodies, 6,965 originals, 59 raw original/copy pairs and all eight observer trees/480 files and exact trace windows. Positive cleanup preceded raw copying; no diagnostic SQL opened. Fresh packet-only consumers and a different nonauthor performance reviewer pass.
- All 27 assets pass anonymous HTTP 200 full-body size/SHA-256 verification and applicable complete recursive CRC/internal-manifest checks. Final reconciliation covers all twelve historical forensic ZIP/checksum pairs; their failed/diagnostic qualification status remains unchanged. Main ZIP: 719,241,445 bytes; SHA256 `b2411b6eb0108b507c8959599a38d050239a21788260470cb87263778e19d8bb`. Its exact 328-member union verifies 5,486 recursive ZIPs, 43,937 manifest entries and 12,249 project files.

Compatibility: migration 0017 adds guarded installation preferences and private regenerable state; project/archive schema3, viewer2 and APIv1 remain. Actual v0.36.0 shared-schema API/archive writing, separate unknown0017 migration refusal, independently old-authored forward migration and current reopen qualify both archive suffixes. Downgrade refuses nondefault preferences or unreaped private work; restore defaults and stop/reap owned work before the supported migration. Use matching client/server versions and a complete pre-upgrade managed-data backup.

Measured limits remain explicit: 38/40 cold edits exceed 2 seconds, 20/40 cache projections and 47/84 feedback observations exceed 100 ms, and all four bulk active updates exceed 5 seconds. Cold median/p95/max is 2,832.35/3,619.9/3,654.1 ms; cache is 100.65/121.8/123.6 ms with zero new warm jobs. Cancellation feedback peaks at 11.5 ms. All 92 renewals/27,243,680 UTF-8 response bytes/132 updates are counted. Mobile retirement latency, wrapper CPU/RSS/load and complete browser/GPU/short-lived-process accounting remain unavailable. Discrete samples are not simultaneous totals; portable bounds pass without strict-host certification or causal speedup/regression claims.

Profiles #160, sidebar #161, filters #162 and final inspector integration #163 remain required under open parent #11. Diagram #153, relocations #164/#165 and the other parent exclusions remain separate. Terminal documentation integration and safe owned-branch cleanup are being completed through the normal process; the runtime tag remains immutable.
